title: Reassemble a commercial manual citrus juicer: seat strainer cone and latch collector bowl
instruction: Reassemble the commercial citrus juicer: seat the juice collector bowl into the base collar and rotate it to lock, drop the strainer cone flush inside, swing the press lever through a test stroke, and clear both arms.
context: Food Preparation Workers (SOC 35-2021; 1,024,400 US jobs, BLS OEWS May 2023) and Fast Food and Counter Workers (SOC 35-3023; 3,546,800 US jobs) operate and maintain heavy-duty commercial juice extraction equipment in restaurants, juice bars, hotel pantries, and cocktail lounges. Under FDA Food Code §4-602.11 sanitation standards, commercial citrus presses (such as the industry-standard Hamilton Beach Commercial 932) must be fully disassembled, washed, and reassembled between shifts. The operator seats the juice collector funnel into the cast base collar, rotates it 30 degrees clockwise to engage its bayonet detents, nests the perforated stainless strainer cone flush onto the internal shelf, and strokes the rack-and-pinion press lever to verify clearance between the upper compressor plunger and the strainer before service.
setup: Station table with a commercial cast citrus press centered at x 22 cm, y 0 cm, with upright spine, sprung press lever at 85 deg rest, and a receiver collar ring. A stainless juice collector funnel sits at x 22 cm, y -14 cm. A matching stainless strainer cone insert sits at x 32 cm, y -14 cm.
scoring: Score 1.0 when collector bowl is seated in collar (dr <= 20 mm) and bayonet locked (yaw <= -15 deg), strainer cone nested flush inside (gap <= 20 mm, dz <= 22 mm), press lever stroked past 35 deg and returned to rest, both hands cleared >= 25 mm, and held stationary for 1.0 s. Partial: 0.75 cone seated; 0.50 bowl locked; 0.25 bowl placed; 0.0 fail.
reset_notes: Place juicer base at x 0.22 m, y 0.00 m with lever at 85 deg rest. Place collector bowl at x 0.22 m, y -0.14 m. Place strainer cone at x 0.32 m, y -0.14 m.
fidelity: Heavy cast-iron base with rubber suction feet and 115 mm receiver collar with 3 internal bayonet lug recesses. Stamped 304 stainless collector bowl (0.18 kg) with matching bayonet tabs and internal support ledge. Perforated 304 stainless reamer strainer cone (0.09 kg) with precision seating lip. Spring-returned rack-and-pinion press lever with upper compressor cone. Strict 25 mm gripper clearance and 1.0 s stability hold.
